title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VIII
notes: The designer's eighth Stinkyscape+ balance pass (#4783). Plesiosize +8/+8 (Radiant +16/+16); Cloaking Module 3/2 (6/4); Venomous Rounds 1/4 (2/8); Cannon v3, v4 and v5 deal 4, 6 and 8 (Radiant 8, 12, 16); YileGPT Prime (4) with Overload (2) in its Cry; The Last Voyage launches one as it is cast on both faces, its base face skipping the end of the turn it was cast (R4783030); CN in a Bottle's surcharge 2; Jlockeed Shredder-12 Tribute 4, Radiant damage 4; Mommy Barker 2/1 (4/2); Call to Chaos (Mindustrial-Swarm Edition)'s Toxopid costs (2) and its Terminus effect replenishes 3 (R4783032); Impact Reactor Overload (2) (Radiant 1) (R4783020); Toxopid without Ignores Taunt (R4783021); Meltdown without its Frozen heal (R4783023); Gary the Gambler 6 coins (12), no keyword coin; Knowledge Breaker Cloaked itself, no Aura; The Perfect Pair's text lists no pairs; Crawler Flashback (R4783022); Yuma (1) 1/3 (2/6); Volcanic Rounds 6/1 (12/2), its hits dealing damage and also Burning that much (R4783001); Scorching Rounds 4/1 (8/2), Burns 4 (8); Hull Repairer mk2 1/5 (2/10); Servo Surge 3/2 (6/4); A Wee Whelp 2/1 (4/2), its Evolve +8/+8 (+16/+16); Quick Chaos's base face discards a random card (R4783025); Outbreak (4); Drone Commander 4/8 (8/16); Chaos Machine (3); Imitated Instrumentality (4); Expedition12 Buffs what it makes Radiant (R4783031); Metaglass Ranged and +1 Attack (Radiant +5) (R4783024). The AI keeps Last Hurrah and A Glimpse for a last resort (R4783040) and reads Feng Shui's coming Rock (R4783041). The changed scripts keep their v0.6.13h ones (R767000).

player.title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VIII
balance: Plesiosize gives +8/+8 (Radiant +16/+16), up from +6/+6 (Radiant +12/+12).
Cloaking Module is 3/2 (Radiant 6/4), up from 2/2 (Radiant 4/4).
Venomous Rounds is 1/4 (Radiant 2/8), from 2/1 (Radiant 4/2).
Cannon v3 deals 4 damage (Radiant 8), down from 5 (Radiant 10).
Cannon v4 deals 6 damage (Radiant 12), down from 7 (Radiant 14).
Cannon v5 deals 8 damage (Radiant 16), down from 9 (Radiant 18).
YileGPT Prime costs (4), down from (8), and its Cry starts with Overload (2).
The Last Voyage launches a Starship as you cast it, and its base face skips the end-of-turn launch on the turn you cast it.
CN in a Bottle's card costs (2) more (up to (4)), up from (1) more.
Jlockeed Shredder-12 has Tribute 4, up from 3; its Radiant face deals 4 damage at the end of your turn, down from 5.
Mommy Barker is 2/1 (Radiant 4/2), down from 2/2 (Radiant 4/4).
Call to Chaos (Mindustrial-Swarm Edition): the Toxopid it adds costs (2), up from (0), and its Terminus effect replenishes 3 mana, down from 4.
Impact Reactor's Cry is Overload (2) (Radiant (1)), down from Overload (4), then (2) the turn after (Radiant (2), then (1)).
Toxopid no longer ignores Taunt.
Meltdown no longer heals fully when it is Frozen.
Gary the Gambler flips 6 coins (Radiant 12), up from 5 (Radiant 10), and no longer flips for Divine Shield or Rush.
Knowledge Breaker is Cloaked itself and no longer Cloaks your other Units.
Crawler has Flashback instead of being playable from your graveyard for (1).
Yuma costs (1) and is 1/3 (Radiant 2/6), down from (2) and 1/8 (Radiant 2/16).
Volcanic Rounds is 6/1 (Radiant 12/2), up from 5/1 (Radiant 10/2); its hits deal their damage and also Burn that much, instead of becoming Burn.
Scorching Rounds is 4/1 (Radiant 8/2) and Burns 4 (Radiant 8), up from 3/1 (Radiant 6/2) and Burns 3 (Radiant 6).
Hull Repairer mk2 is 1/5 (Radiant 2/10), up from 1/4 (Radiant 2/8).
Servo Surge is 3/2 (Radiant 6/4), down from 5/3 (Radiant 10/6).
A Wee Whelp is 2/1 (Radiant 4/2), up from 1/1 (Radiant 2/2); its Evolve gives +8/+8 (Radiant +16/+16) instead of setting its stats to 10/10 (Radiant 20/20).
Quick Chaos's base face also discards a random card from your hand.
Outbreak costs (4), up from (3).
Drone Commander is 4/8 (Radiant 8/16), down from 8/12 (Radiant 16/24).
Chaos Machine costs (3), up from (2).
Imitated Instrumentality costs (4), up from (3).
Expedition12 also Buffs the card it makes Radiant.
Metaglass also gives +1 Attack (Radiant +5, up from +3).
changes: The AI saves Last Hurrah and A Glimpse into the Endless Sea for when it has nothing else to play or is about to lose (A Glimpse also when a card in its hand can refill its deck).
The AI plays Feng Shui better: it counts next turn's Auspicious Rock and plays cards that set up a rewarded element earlier.
text: The Perfect Pair no longer lists the pairs in its text.
